result.title: 4D Reconstruction with Events & RGB
result.comment: Accepted at NeVi 2026 workshop at the 19th European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV 2026)
result.summary: Reconstructing dynamic 3D scenes over time (4D reconstruction) from a single moving camera is central to robotics and AR/VR applications, yet state-of the-art feed-forward methods rely solely on RGB frames and therefore inherit the failure modes of conventional cameras, including motion blur and temporal aliasing under fast or non-uniform camera and object motion. Event cameras report per-pixel brightness changes asynchronously at microsecond resolution, offering a complementary signal that is largely immune to these artifacts, but whether this modality can be incorporated into existing RGB based 4D reconstruction pipelines without a full architectural redesign remains an open question. In this preliminary study, we investigate a minimal extension: we augment Monst3R, an existing RGB-only 4D reconstruction model, with an additional event-camera input branch, leaving the rest of the architecture unchanged. Across 3 benchmark datasets, this simple RGB-event fusion reduces Abs Rel by 3.4% on average relative to the RGB-only Monst3R baseline, and a sensitivity analysis shows that the improvement grows with the magnitude of camera and object motion, with the largest gains observed under high object motion conditions where RGB-only reconstruction degrades most. These early results suggest that even a lightweight, non-invasive fusion of event data can meaningfully improve 4D reconstruction robustness, motivating a more thorough architectural investigation in future work.

AI.brief_summary: 该文在 Monst3R 的 RGB-only 4D 重建模型上增加事件相机输入分支，在三个基准上验证轻量 RGB-事件融合可提升动态场景重建精度。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究目标是动态 3D/4D 几何重建，未涉及 VLM 推理状态、视觉证据筛选、动态计算或停止决策，事件模态融合也不构成可供核查的 latent 推理线索。
